title: How Alle's ClinX Container Recovery Works
excerpt: Alle's ClinX container recovery is normally linked to the next delivery: empty cans are collected together on site and picked up when the next order arrives, with care support available when an earlier pickup is needed.
seo_title: How Alle's ClinX Container Recovery Works | Alle's ClinX
meta_description: Learn how to store Alle's ClinX empty containers for recovery, when collection normally happens and how to request an earlier pickup.
content_html:
Alle's ClinX uses a delivery-linked approach for recovering eligible empty containers. The normal process is to collect empties at the facility and return them when the next delivery arrives rather than arranging a separate pickup every time a container is emptied.

Collect empty containers in one place

Keep used containers together in a defined collection area so they are easy to identify and do not become mixed with new stock.

Keep empties separate from usable inventory

A simple separation between empty returns and new/active stock reduces confusion during storage and receiving.

The next delivery is the normal collection point

When the next Alle's ClinX order arrives, the accumulated empties can be handed back through the same logistics movement.

Earlier pickup can be requested

If the containers cannot reasonably remain on site until the next delivery, contact care@allesclinx.com to ask about an earlier pickup.

Do not improvise a return treatment

Follow the current Alle's ClinX return instructions for the container type. The published guidance does not require customers to thoroughly clean or sort empty cans by product before normal collection; they should simply be kept together and accessible.

Care can help confirm timing

If the next delivery date is unclear, the care team can help confirm the expected timing or advise on the appropriate recovery route.

Practical takeaway

Collect empties, keep them separate from new stock and return them at the next delivery. Contact care when the containers need to move sooner.
